Statistics alone are a very solid reason to consider the disguised Queen for your deck! But there's more! For one thing, this version of the Amidala persona is a Republic character, thus unaffected by anything that targets Rebels. For example, [[Charming To The Last]], [[Put All Sections On Alert]] and the popular Scum deck helper, [[None Shall Pass]], all fall flat when faced with this Republican. Of course, her real kicker is in her game text. Besides the fact that her Jedi protectors keep her safe from weapon fire, she can even 'download' them! Twice per game, deploy Qui-Gon or [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] to Padmé's site. That's a very fast way to get out any version of two of your biggest characters. And of course, you could just use it to get Qui-Gon twice to stall an opponent's Hunt Down, or perhaps [[Ben Kenobi]] twice to push your Profit deck along. So what are her disdvantages? Only one, but it is red, black and nasty — [[Darth Maul]] is looking for her. But even then, Padmé benefits — if Dark Side is playing a 'Hunt The Queen' strategy (I Will Find Them Quickly Master and the Epic Event, [[If The Trace Was Correct]]) then she can deploy straight from your Reserve Deck. Put [[Panaka's Blaster]] on him and he fires it for free, draws weapon destiny +2, and, if he hits, your opponent loses 2 Force. Pretty sharp shootin'! The real kicker? Back in 1996, the Dark Side got the [[Death Star (Special Edition){{!}}Death Star]] system in [[A New Hope]]. Now, the Light Side gets the first 3/0 site to balance things out. Any location that is so incredible for generating Force serves as a two-edged sword and poses a great danger for the person playing it. One must be extremely cautious to not allow it to fall into enemy hands, lest those 3 icons of Force-generating goodness be turned into a painful Force drain of 3 each turn. Fortunately, this new Light side mega-Force engine is custom-built to be the staging ground for the powerful and mysterious Jedi Council. Most of the Council members are completely immune to attrition there, and many cannot deploy anywhere else. Many of the strongest mechanics of these members (like those of [[Mace Windu]] and [[Depa Billaba]]) function only when that Jedi Master is contemplating the universe from within the sacred chambers. Another great feature of this locale is the ability to "download" [[Yoda, Senior Council Member]], who can then act to disperse your Jedi around the galaxy and augment your forces elsewhere. Combos: Use the Council Chamber as your "other [E1] location" on the Senator Objective to start yourself out with 4 Force icons while giving your opponent only 1. Use this Interrupt to deploy your JCC, or (once it's out) to get those Jedi Council members out of your deck and into the Council Chamber where they belong. |combos=* [[Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]] + [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion{{!}}Plead My Case To The Senate]] Objective[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Coruscant%3A%20Jedi%20Council%20Chamber Scomp: Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec).
